She bought 1 Bitcoin (bitcoin:native), at $500, and a SIM swap took it all.

By the time she checked her Coinbase balance, it read zero.

We sat down with Mark Kreitzman (GM at @efani) to break down how SIM swaps actually work, and why crypto holders are the highest-value targets…
